name: Insert Fee Structure
Deposit Validation
Add Discount
script:
def calculate_final_discount(discount1, discount2):
    final_percentage = 100 - (100 - discount1) * (100 - discount2) / 100
    return final_percentage

fee_name = frappe.form_dict.fee_name
discount = frappe.form_dict.discount

fees = frappe.get_doc("Fees", fee_name)
dis = frappe.get_doc("Discount Configuration", discount)

total_discount = 0
total_amount = 0
for component in fees.components:
    total_amount = total_amount + component.amount
    if component.fees_category == dis.fee_category and component.custom_discounts != discount:
        discount_name = component.custom_discounts
        if discount_name is not None and dis.can_be_applied_with_other_discounts == 1:
            # if the discount is already present and the new discount could be applied with other discounts
            discount_name = f"{discount_name}, {dis.name}" if discount_name is not None else discount_name
            final_discount = calculate_final_discount(dis.discount, component.custom_discount_percentage)
            discounted_amount = (component.amount * float(final_discount)) / 100
            amount = component.amount - discounted_amount
        else:
            # if the discount is not already present
            discount_name = dis.name
            discounted_amount = (component.amount * float(dis.discount)) / 100
            amount = component.amount - discounted_amount
            
        # updating the data in the database
        frappe.db.set_value("Fee Component", component.name, "custom_discounts", discount_name)
        frappe.db.set_value("Fee Component", component.name, "custom_discount_percentage", dis.discount)
        frappe.db.set_value("Fee Component", component.name, "custom_discount_amount", discounted_amount)
        frappe.db.set_value("Fee Component", component.name, "custom_amount_after_discount", amount)
        grand_total = fees.grand_total - discounted_amount
        frappe.response['message'] = {"fees": fees, "dis":dis, "discount": discount_name}

grand_total_in_words = str(frappe.utils.in_words(grand_total)).title()
frappe.db.set_value("Fees", fees.name, "grand_total", grand_total)
frappe.db.set_value("Fees", fees.name, "grand_total_in_words", grand_total_in_words)
frappe.db.set_value("Fees", fees.name, "outstanding_amount", grand_total)

for i, component in enumerate(doc.components):
    total_amount = total_amount + component.amount
    if frappe.db.exists("Discount Configuration", {"fee_structure": doc.fee_structure, "fee_category": component.fees_category, "enabled": 1}):

        doc.components[i].custom_discount_percentage = dis.discount
        discounted_amount = (component.amount * float(dis.discount)) / 100
        doc.components[i].custom_discount_amount = discounted_amount
        doc.components[i].custom_amount_after_discount = component.amount - discounted_amount
        total_discount = total_discount + discounted_amount
    else:
        doc.components[i].custom_amount_after_discount = component.amount
        
doc.grand_total = total_amount - total_discount
doc.grand_total_in_words = str(frappe.utils.in_words(doc.grand_total)).title()
doc.outstanding_amount = doc.grand_total

if doc.payment_plan:
    for i in doc.payment_schedule:
        i.payment_amount = doc.grand_total * (i.invoice_portion/100)

referred_by = doc.custom_referred_by
ref = frappe.get_doc("Referral Settings")
try:
    referral_amount = float(ref.referral[0].referral_amount)
except:
    referral_amount = 0

if frappe.db.exists("Referral Log", {"student_id": referred_by}):
    ref_log = frappe.get_doc("Referral Log", {"student_id": referred_by})
    number_of_referral = int(ref_log.number_of_referral)+1
    ref_log.number_of_referral = number_of_referral
    
    # get referral amount with reference to the number of referral
    for r in ref.referral:
        if r.idx == number_of_referral:
            referral_amount = int(r.referral_amount)
            ref_log.referral_amount = referral_amount
        
    ref_log.save(ignore_permissions=True)
else:
    ref_log = frappe.new_doc("Referral Log")
    ref_log.student_id = referred_by
    ref_log.number_of_referral = 1
    ref_log.referral_amount = referral_amount
    ref_log.save(ignore_permissions=True)

name: Referral Discount in Fees
script:
total_amount = 0
filters = {"type": "Referral", "enabled": 1}
if frappe.db.exists("Referral Log", {"student_id": doc.student}):
    ref = frappe.get_doc("Referral Log", {"student_id": doc.student})
    total_discount = discount = float(ref.referral_amount)
    for i, component in enumerate(doc.components):
        total_amount = total_amount + component.amount
        if component.amount > discount and discount != 0:
            if frappe.db.exists("Discount Configuration", filters):
                dis = frappe.get_doc("Discount Configuration", filters)
                discount_name = doc.components[i].custom_discounts
                doc.components[i].custom_discounts = f"{discount_name}, {dis.name}" if discount_name is not None else dis.name
                doc.components[i].custom_discount_percentage = 0
                doc.components[i].custom_discount_amount = discount
                doc.components[i].custom_amount_after_discount = component.amount - discount
            discount = 0
        else:
            doc.components[i].custom_amount_after_discount = component.amount
    
    doc.grand_total = total_amount - total_discount
    doc.grand_total_in_words = str(frappe.utils.in_words(doc.grand_total)).title()
    doc.outstanding_amount = doc.grand_total
    
def calculate_amount(amount, invoice_portion):
    amount = frappe.utils.flt((invoice_portion/100) * amount,2)
    return amount
    
if doc.payment_plan:
    pp = frappe.get_doc("Payment Plan",doc.payment_plan)
    doc.payment_schedule = []
    for schedule in pp.payment_schedule:
        payment_amount = calculate_amount(doc.outstanding_amount, schedule.invoice_portion)
        doc.append("payment_schedule",{
            'payment_term': schedule.payment_term,
            'description': schedule.description,
            'due_date': schedule.due_date,
            'invoice_portion': schedule.invoice_portion,
            'payment_amount': payment_amount,
            'outstanding': payment_amount,
        })

name: Remove Discount
script:
def get_discount_list(input_string):
    split_strings = input_string.split(',')
    stripped_values = [value.strip() for value in split_strings]
    return stripped_values

fee_name = frappe.form_dict.fee_name
discount = frappe.form_dict.discount

fees = frappe.get_doc("Fees", fee_name)
dis = frappe.get_doc("Discount Configuration", discount)

total_discount = 0
total_amount = 0
grand_total = fees.grand_total
for component in fees.components:
    total_amount = total_amount + component.amount
    if component.custom_discounts:
        discount_list = get_discount_list(component.custom_discounts)
        if component.fees_category == dis.fee_category and discount in discount_list:
            discounted_amount = (component.amount * float(dis.discount)) / 100
            discount_list.remove(discount)
            discount = ",".join(discount_list)
            # updating the data in the database
            frappe.db.set_value("Fee Component", component.name, "custom_discounts", discount)
            frappe.db.set_value("Fee Component", component.name, "custom_discount_percentage", 0)
            frappe.db.set_value("Fee Component", component.name, "custom_discount_amount", 0)
            frappe.db.set_value("Fee Component", component.name, "custom_amount_after_discount", component.amount)
            grand_total = grand_total + discounted_amount
            frappe.response['message'] = {"fees": fees, "dis":dis, "discount": discount}

grand_total_in_words = str(frappe.utils.in_words(grand_total)).title()
frappe.db.set_value("Fees", fees.name, "grand_total", grand_total)
frappe.db.set_value("Fees", fees.name, "grand_total_in_words", grand_total_in_words)
frappe.db.set_value("Fees", fees.name, "outstanding_amount", grand_total)
